seo.title: Lunch at OSH Del Mar — Terrace Dining Above the Marina, JBR
seo.description: Four courses for 150 AED, or 20% off à la carte. Daily 2–6 PM on the M-floor terrace at Address Beach Resort. Free valet. Request your table in 30 seconds.
seo.ogImageAlt: The terrace at OSH Del Mar at sunset, overlooking Dubai Marina

hero.eyebrow: OSH DEL MAR · ADDRESS BEACH RESORT, M FLOOR

view.h1: The lunch that ends with sunset over the sea
view.sub: Four courses for 150 AED, or 20% off the à la carte menu. Daily, 2 to 6 PM, on the terrace above Dubai Marina.

business.h1: Some deals close better with a sea view
business.sub: A four-course business lunch, 150 AED, on the terrace above Dubai Marina. Daily 2 to 6 PM. Free valet, and quiet enough to actually talk.

price.h1: An Address Beach Resort dinner, at lunch prices
price.sub: Same kitchen, same terrace, same view — just before 6 PM. Four courses for 150 AED, or 20% off everything à la carte.

offer.heading: Two ways to do lunch here
offer.sub: Both run daily, 2 to 6 PM. Pick one when you request your table — you can still change your mind with the host on the day.

cards.title: Four-course business lunch
cards.footnote: Served in about an hour, if you're on a clock.

cards.title: 20% off the à la carte menu
items: The charcoal grill, the tandoor, the full cocktail list
Dry-aged seabass and hamachi from the fish bar
À la carte averages around {{AVG_CHECK}} per person — so this is roughly what the set menu costs, with the whole menu open to you

offer.closing: Come at 2 and make an afternoon of it. Come at 5 and the sun goes down while you're still at the table — in Dubai it lands right in the middle of the last seating.

socialProof.heading: People come back for the terrace
socialProof.ratingLine: ★ {{RATING}} on Google · {{REVIEW_COUNT}} reviews · Featured in TimeOut Dubai and VisitDubai

gallery.heading: The M floor, from 2 PM to sunset
gallery.sub: The terrace sits above The Walk at JBR, facing the marina and Ain Dubai. Inside, the room is built around the open grills.

menu.heading: What's in the four courses
menu.sub: Modern Uzbek cooking with a seafood hand — charcoal, smoke and a tandoor, run by a kitchen that also keeps the first dry-aged fish bar in Dubai.
menu.closing: The dry-aged seabass and hamachi live on the à la carte menu. It's the first dry-aged fish bar in the city, and it's the reason a lot of people come back for dinner after finding us at lunch.

items.label: Getting here
items.body: Address Beach Resort, The Walk, JBR. Take the lift to the M floor — the restaurant is straight ahead.

items.label: Parking
items.body: Valet is free. Just tell them you're dining at OSH Del Mar.

items.label: Timing
items.body: Service runs 2 to 6 PM daily. Last seating {{LAST_SEATING}}.

items.label: Dress code
items.body: Smart casual. The terrace gets a breeze after five.

items.label: Children
items.body: Welcome. High chairs available — mention it in the notes.

items.label: Dietary
items.body: Vegetarian options across all four courses. Tell us about allergies when you request the table and the kitchen will work around them.

items.q: Will I get a table with a view?
items.a: Ask for one in the notes and we'll do our best. Terrace tables go first on weekends, so the earlier you send the request, the better your odds. Every table indoors faces the windows.
No. Nothing is charged when you request a table. You pay at the restaurant, as normal. Groups of {{GROUP_THRESHOLD}} or more may need a deposit — the host will tell you when confirming.
Within 15 minutes between 10 AM and 11 PM. Send it later than that and you'll hear from us first thing in the morning.

items.q: Can I change or cancel it?
items.a: Yes, any time. Reply in the same WhatsApp chat and we'll move it or cancel it. No fee, no questions.
Message us in the same chat. We hold tables for {{LATE_POLICY}} — after that we'll seat you as soon as something opens up.

items.q: Can you take a group of ten or more?
items.a: Yes. Put the number in the notes and the host will call you to set it up properly — big tables on the terrace need a little planning.

form.heading: Request your table
form.sub: Two steps, about thirty seconds. We confirm on WhatsApp.

step2.heading: Where should we confirm?

notes.label: Anything we should know?
notes.placeholder: Birthday, a table by the terrace rail, a high chair…

step2.microcopy: No prepayment. We'll confirm on WhatsApp within 15 minutes — or first thing in the morning if it's after 11 PM.

errors.nameRequired: We'll need a name for the table.
errors.phoneRequired: We confirm on WhatsApp, so we need a number.
errors.phoneInvalid: That number doesn't look right. Include the country code, like +971 50 123 4567.
errors.emailInvalid: That email looks off — check the spelling, or just leave it blank.
errors.dateTimeRequired: Pick a date and time first.
errors.consentRequired: Tick the box so we're allowed to message you back.
errors.slotUnavailable: That slot is full. The closest we have is {{ALT_TIME}} — or try another day.
errors.network: That didn't go through. Check your connection and try again — everything you typed is still here.
errors.server: Something broke on our side. Message the host on WhatsApp and they'll sort it out right now.

whatsappBlock.body: A table for twelve, a birthday, a question about the terrace — talk to the host directly.
